CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_accounting_close_certificate(p_kind text, p_union_id uuid, p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT c.value FROM public.accounting_close_certificates c
  WHERE COALESCE(current_setting('app.weekly_accounting_chunked',true),'')='on'
    AND current_setting('app.accounting_close_memo',true)='on'
    AND c.kind=p_kind AND c.union_id=p_union_id AND c.period_start=p_start AND c.period_end=p_end
    AND c.certified_at>=p_end AND c.certified_at>clock_timestamp()-interval '12 hours'
$function$
signature: fn_accounting_close_certificate(text,uuid,timestamp with time zone,timestamp with time zone)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_inventory_immutable()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original_pnl_inventory_is_immutable' USING ERRCODE='55000'; END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_posthand_escrow_touch(h union_pnl_cash_outcome_touches)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE o public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes;
BEGIN
 SELECT q.* INTO o FROM public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes q WHERE q.table_id=h.table_id AND q.hand_number=h.hand_number;
 IF NOT FOUND OR o.recognized_at IS DISTINCT FROM h.recognized_at
  OR o.game_scope->>'game_union_id' IS DISTINCT FROM h.game_union_id
  OR o.evidence->>'accepted_rake' IS DISTINCT FROM h.accepted_rake
  OR public.fn_union_pnl_compact_participants(o.evidence->'participants') IS DISTINCT FROM h.participants THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'posthand_escrow_projection_touch_disagrees' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 RETURN public.fn_union_pnl_posthand_escrow_participants(o);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_projection_ready(p_projection text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT COALESCE((SELECT b.completed_at IS NOT NULL FROM public.union_pnl_projection_build b WHERE b.projection=p_projection),false)
$function$
